2/ SNL goes live.

$DOGE hits $0.73 — everyone waiting for liftoff.

Elon says one line during a skit:

“It’s a hustle.”

The crowd laughs.
Crypto doesn’t.

The dump begins.

#CryptoCrash #SNL #Dogecoin #CTpanic https://t.co/px4qKO6xmw

1/ The hype was unreal.

Elon was tweeting about DOGE daily.
“Dogefather.”
“Doge to the moon.”
He even said he bought some for his kid.

By the time SNL aired, $DOGE was up over 30,000% YTD.

#MemeCoinSeason #ElonMusk #CryptoHype https://t.co/yYQR7j1TyN

Throwback Thursday: The night $DOGE died on live TV

May 8, 2021.
Elon Musk hosted SNL.
$DOGE was flying — CT was convinced it would hit $1.

Instead… it crashed mid-show.
